# Deployment image pull failure

Inspect `<DEPLOYMENT>` using the deployment binding. An unavailable Deployment with an owned, current-image pod waiting in ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull and no image ID matches the confirmed signature. Startup waits, application crashes, deleted pods, old-image pods, and available Deployments do not establish this fault.

The successful repair restored the previously verified image and pinned it in source. Reconcile only after confirming that reviewed source contains the intended pullable image. Pull failures can also involve registry access; this signature does not establish that every pull failure is an invalid image name. If source is also incorrect, review source or rollout history before approving recovery.

The existing health-objective detector supplies the availability and endpoint findings. This program adds causal diagnosis rather than duplicating that detector. Reservation port drift was repaired in the incident but its diagnosis was not independently confirmed, so it is outside this program.
